profile.description: Jamjoom Pharmaceuticals Factory Company, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and distribution of pharmaceutical and consumer products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Gulf, Iraq, Egypt, North Africa, and internationally. It provides human medicines; nutraceuticals; antibiotics; general analgesics; medicines for treatment of cough, allergy, asthma, heart diseases, blood pressure, diarrhea, vomiting, and ulcer and acidity; treatment of various skin infections and cancer diseases; and eye drops, and ointments and cosmeceuticals. The company also offers ophthalmic solutions, dermatology products, cardiovascular health, consumer health, respiratory health, gastrointestinal health, endocrinology and diabetes care, central nervous system, and pain and inflammation pharmaceutical products. Jamjoom Pharmaceuticals Factory Company was founded in 1994 and is based in Jeddah, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
